relatorio.healthlowWeightMaintain: Keep building consistency with adequate nutrition, rest and moderate movement.
relatorio.healthnormalSummary: The latest BMI is within the healthy zone, a favourable reading for the current profile.
relatorio.healthnormalImprovement: Maintain the balance between daily movement, varied nutrition, regular sleep and follow-up assessment.
relatorio.healthnormalMaintain: Continue regular activity, balanced nutrition, good hydration and consistent sleep.
relatorio.healthoverweightSummary: The latest BMI suggests overweight, so it is worth improving active routine, nutrition and follow-up.
relatorio.healthoverweightImprovement: Increase progressive aerobic activity, reduce sedentary time and combine it with consistent food choices.
relatorio.healthoverweightMaintain: Consolidate small weekly changes and reassess to follow the trend.
relatorio.healthobesitySummary: The latest BMI indicates obesity, a zone that needs closer follow-up and a progressive plan.
relatorio.healthobesityImprovement: Prioritise low-impact movement, gradually increase active time and coordinate the plan with health professionals.
relatorio.healthobesityMaintain: Focus on consistency, safety and regular follow-up before increasing intensity.

registerLanding.title: Create a new account
registerLanding.description: Select the account type that best describes your relationship with the school. You can register as a Student or as a Guardian.
registerLanding.studentDescription: Access your physical assessment history, well-being questionnaires and progress reports.
registerLanding.guardianDescription: Track your children's progress and view reports shared by the school.
registerLanding.backToLogin: Already have an account — Sign In

registerStudent.title: Create student account
registerStudent.description: Fill in the fields below to create your account. You will need your process number to confirm the school association.
registerStudent.emailHint: Use the email provided by the school.
registerStudent.processNumberHint: The process number is on your student card or available at the school office.
registerStudent.passwordRules: Minimum 8 characters. Use uppercase, lowercase and numbers.
registerStudent.consentLabel: I accept that my health data will be stored and processed for physical fitness assessment purposes, under GDPR.

registerGuardian.title: Create guardian account
registerGuardian.description: Fill in the fields below to create your account. Your child's process number is required to complete the association.
registerGuardian.processNumberHint: The process number is on your student card or available at the school office.
registerGuardian.passwordRules: Minimum 8 characters. Use uppercase, lowercase and numbers.
registerGuardian.consentLabel: I accept that my child's health data will be stored and processed for physical fitness assessment purposes, under GDPR.

authLayout.headline: Health. Fitness. Care.
authLayout.subtitle: Physical assessment records, well-being questionnaires and alerts — for students, teachers and guardians.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.description: An unexpected error occurred. Try again or contact support if the problem persists.

verifyEmail.title: Email verification
verifyEmail.missingDescription: The verification link is missing or invalid. Try requesting a new verification link.
verifyEmail.invalidDescription: This verification link is invalid or has already been used. Request a new one.
verifyEmail.expiredDescription: This verification link has expired. Links are valid for 24 hours. Request a new one.
verifyEmail.studentDescription: The student associated with this link could not be found. Check the details or contact the school.

changePasswordPage.title: Change password
changePasswordPage.description: Enter your current password and set a new one.
changePasswordPage.forcedNotice: For security reasons, you must set a new password before continuing.
changePasswordPage.passwordRules: Minimum 8 characters. Use uppercase, lowercase and numbers.
